# 2 Chronicles Chapter 22 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-they-made-king inhabitants-of Jerusalem Ahaziah his-son the-youngest in-his-place for all the-older-ones killed the-band that came with-the-Arabians to-the-camp and-he-reigned Ahaziah son-of Jehoram king-of Judah.

**2** Son-of forty-and-two years was-Ahaziah in-his-reigning and-one year he-reigned in-Jerusalem and-name-of his-mother was-Athaliah granddaughter-of Omri.

**3** Also he walked in-ways-of house-of Ahab for his-mother was his-counselor to-act-wickedly.

**4** And-he-did the-evil in-eyes-of YHWH like-house-of Ahab for they were to-him counselors after death-of his-father to-his-destruction.

**5** Also in-their-counsel he-walked and-he-went with Jehoram son-of Ahab king-of Israel to-war against Hazael king-of Aram at-Ramoth-gilead and-they-struck the-Arameans Joram.

**6** And-he-returned to-heal in-Jezreel from the-wounds that they-struck-him in-Ramah in-his-fighting with Hazael king-of Aram and-Azariah son-of Jehoram king-of Judah went-down to-see Jehoram son-of Ahab in-Jezreel for sick he was.

**7** And-from-God was the-downfall-of Ahaziah to-come to Joram and-in-his-coming he-went-out with Jehoram against Jehu son-of Nimshi whom anointed YHWH to-cut-off house-of Ahab.

**8** And-it-was as-judging Jehu with house-of Ahab and-he-found the-princes-of Judah and-sons-of brothers-of Ahaziah serving Ahaziah and-he-killed-them.

**9** And-he-sought Ahaziah and-they-captured-him and-he was-hiding in-Samaria and-they-brought-him to Jehu and-they-killed-him and-they-buried-him for they-said son-of Jehoshaphat he who sought YHWH with-all his-heart and-there-was-none for-house-of Ahaziah to-retain-power for-the-kingdom.

**10** And-Athaliah mother-of Ahaziah she-saw that dead was her-son and-she-arose and-she-destroyed all seed-of the-kingdom of-house-of Judah.

**11** And-she-took Jehoshabeath daughter-of the-king Joash son-of Ahaziah and-she-stole-him from-midst-of sons-of the-king the-being-killed and-she-put him and-his-nurse in-room-of the-beds and-she-hid-him Jehoshabeath daughter-of the-king Jehoram wife-of Jehoiada the-priest for she was sister-of Ahaziah from Athaliah and-not she-killed-him.

**12** And-he-was with-them in-house-of God hiding six years and-Athaliah reigning over the-land.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **22:3**: his-mother was his-counselor to-act-wickedly — Athaliah, daughter of Ahab, functions as the conduit of Baalism into the Davidic line. Her counsel is explicitly identified as the source of Ahaziah's corruption.

- **22:7**: from-God was the-downfall — The Chronicler attributes Ahaziah's destruction directly to divine causation. God uses Jehu's revolution as the instrument of judgment.

- **22:10**: she-destroyed all seed-of the-kingdom — Athaliah's attempted genocide of the royal line is the most dangerous moment for the Davidic covenant in the entire Hebrew Bible.

- **22:11**: Jehoshabeath — Her marriage to the high priest Jehoiada connects the royal and priestly lines, enabling the preservation of the Davidic dynasty.


— EMET
